speaker: Mr Alex Yam
text: asked	the Minister for National Development how will farmers affected by the land acquisition for the expansion of Tengah Airbase be (i) assisted and (ii) compensated.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: I add my voice to congratulate Mr Speaker on your election.

speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: There are also the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board schemes like the Capability Development Grant that these establishments can tap on.
